hero.title: BBS in Mauritius for Indian Students
paras: A Bachelor of Business Studies (BBS) is an undergraduate degree that covers business principles, management, accounting, finance, marketing, economics and organizational operations. It can be suitable for students wishing to prepare themselves for careers in business, administration, financial services, entrepreneurship or for further education in management. **BBS in Mauritius** is a study option for students interested in undergraduate business education and developing a foundation in business-related subjects.

highlights.title: Bilingual & English Degrees
highlights.desc: Study in English with recognized qualifications from national institutions and global UK/Australian branch campuses.

highlights.title: Affordable Tuition & Living
highlights.desc: High quality tertiary education with tuition fees and living costs substantially lower than Western Europe.

highlights.title: Safe & Multicultural Island
highlights.desc: Consistently ranked as the safest and most politically stable nation in Africa with close cultural ties to India.

highlights.title: Simplified Visa Process
highlights.desc: Streamlined student visa procedures arranged directly through recognized higher education institutions.

overview: Students in Mauritius need to know the difference between a degree called Bachelor of Business Studies (BBS) and other degrees such as Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA), Bachelor of Business Management or BSc (Hons) Business Management. The University of Mauritius lists business management degrees for 2026-2027, and Honoris Educational Network advertizes a BBA delivered through supported distance learning. Students searching for a **Bachelor of Business Studies in Mauritius** should confirm the exact qualification title and awarding institution before applying.

items.q: Can Indian students apply for BBS in Mauritius?
items.a: Yes, Indian students meeting the academic criteria and English proficiency requirements can apply to recognized Mauritian institutions.

items.q: What is the medium of instruction for BBS in Mauritius?
items.a: Programmes at major Mauritian universities are delivered in English, with bilingual options available at select institutions.

items.q: What are the typical tuition fees for BBS in Mauritius?
items.a: Tuition fees generally range between MUR 150,000 and MUR 350,000 per year, offering cost-effective international degree options.

items.q: Is a student visa required for Indian students?
items.a: Yes, international students require an entry permit and student visa issued by the Passport and Immigration Office of Mauritius upon receiving admission.
